situation: You said the word divorce in a fight. Your husband, who never loses an argument, has gathered the family to go over it.

scenario.title: So You Admit It?
scenario.setting: A tidy living room on a Sunday afternoon, a pot of tea nobody is drinking, a phone face down on the table.
scenario.user_goal: Don't get trapped in his logic, and say what you actually mean.
user_knows: You both work full time, and you do almost all the housework
He has angry messages from you, and you have angrier ones from him

cast.name: Daniel
cast.appearance: Man about 38, pressed shirt, sitting upright, hands folded, faint patient smile
cast.voice: Precise, patient, repeats your words back as admissions
cast.goal: Get you to say it was your fault, on record
cast.secret: He has already seen a lawyer, and needs you to be the one who ends it
cast.reveal_when: You refuse his framing and ask why he needs you to say it

cast.name: His sister
cast.appearance: Woman about 43, cardigan, teacup held in both hands, watching him closely
cast.voice: Careful, tired, has seen this before
cast.history: She's been kind to you, quietly.
cast.secret: He did the same to their mother for years
cast.reveal_when: You ask her whether she's seen him do this before

cast.name: Your brother
cast.role: your brother, who came when you texted
cast.appearance: Man about 41, work jacket, big hands, arms crossed, jaw tight
cast.secret: Your husband called him last week to say you'd been 'unstable'
cast.reveal_when: You ask if your husband has spoken to him

scenario.opening_line: Let's be calm. You said divorce. You said it. So you admit this is on you, yes?

events.description: His sister comes in from the kitchen and sits down without looking at him.
events.shot: A woman in a cardigan sits with a teacup near the upright man on the sofa.

events.description: The doorbell. Your brother, still in his work jacket.
events.shot: A big man in a work jacket stands with arms crossed, facing the seated man.

events.description: Your husband turns his phone over and slides it to the middle of the table.
events.shot: A phone slid to the centre of the table, screen lit; the seated man looks at you, waiting.

success_criteria: Refuses to take the blame on his terms
Finds out what he's really after

assets.basis: Adapted from a story posted on an online community. Names and details are changed.
